introduction.text_002: Your director or teacher uses Program Partner to run your program. Here's how to get in and what you'll find.

getting_in.text_004: Your director or teacher sets up your account. You'll get a registration code or an email invitation from your program. Program Partner doesn't create accounts on its own, so if you haven't heard anything, ask your director or teacher.
getting_in.text_008: . It works on any phone, tablet or computer. On a phone or tablet, you can add it to your home screen so it opens like an app. There's nothing to download.
getting_in.text_010: What you owe, what you've paid, and a receipt for each payment.
getting_in.text_011: Forms to fill out and sign.
getting_in.text_012: Announcements, the program calendar and messages from staff.
getting_in.text_013: For students: your own balance, your assignments and your music.

paying_help_and_privacy.text_015: Payments go straight to your program's account, never to Program Partner. Your program decides how you can pay.
paying_help_and_privacy.text_017: Questions about fees, events or schedules: ask your director or teacher.
paying_help_and_privacy.text_020: Your information belongs to your school or program. Program Partner never sells it and never uses it for advertising.

woodshed.text_022: Woodshed is our free practice site for band, orchestra and choir students. No sign-in needed.
